scope: Material/source/document/visual review of existing cross-year L/H geometry. Does not certify original survey dimensions or replace independent topology/material-region/clean-rebuild checks.
observations: Viewed all five completed v2 PNGs after render-v2 APPEARANCE_DONE and Blender quit. Front now presents inner courtyard and rear the outer arc; no reliance on v1 camera labels.
Inner walls/pier family pale beige-grey, actual window backings muted grey-green, convex entry backings slightly deeper blue-green agree with limited aerial source evidence.
Pink-brown pergola stays within existing roof-edge assembly; tall stair cores remain neutral rather than colored by broad rail bbox.
Oval visible broad-slot half pale beige-grey with five horizontal green-grey openings; opposite half, inner opening and top ring neutral. No invented narrow slot stripe.
Rear external windows and large roof remain neutral; no blue PV painting, added equipment or source-photo textures.
Top view retains readable neutral roof shading without white clipping. All five views frame complete model with margins.
remaining_limits: 2022 report is not capture date; photos45/64 visibly differ in PV state. Original model omits PV.
Photo fading/screen pattern means broad approximate colors only, not calibrated finish values.
Original cross-year registration, height/grade/basement estimates and thickened roof lattice remain unchanged.
